verdicts.reason: The two candidates are identical apart from the red 'LONGEST DAY SALE' banner. In A it sits low and its right end runs into the translucent decorative circle, which looks like an accidental collision. In B it sits clear of the circle, just under the logo. Both share the same serious flaws. The subcopy, CTA and legal text are crammed into one bottom row, and the legal text is pushed into the dark-red circle at the right edge, where it is low-contrast and almost touches the edge. The banner has shrunk from the original's hero element to a small sticker. The left-centre is empty dead space, the logo, bottle and copy blocks don't line up on any shared edge, and the hierarchy is weak.
